Both modules are hash-bound to the already-accepted original and replacement 13W M5 capture (OLD_ZIP_SHA256/REPLACEMENT_ZIP_SHA256) and to the already-accepted current broker-universe metadata zip (CURRENT_BROKER_UNIVERSE_ZIP_SHA256/PAYLOAD_SHA256) rather than any new data source. tests/test_relative_value_epoch24_diagnostic.py and tests/test_relative_value_epoch24_pair_data.py already cover UTC alignment, missing-bar/duplicate handling, product-comparability guards, deterministic hashing, chronological split boundaries, synthetic cointegrated/non-cointegrated fixtures, holdout-mutation-cannot-change-hedge leakage proof, plan-mutation rejection (holdout_refit=True raises), and a no-economic-effect assertion on diagnose_pair output -- satisfying the required unit, fixture, leakage and regression tests. The remaining execution step (running execute()/main() against the accepted-but-git-external binary capture bytes to materialize the final diagnostic-result JSON) is not a new external data need -- those zips are already-accepted, hash-bound artifacts external to Git by design -- and is gated by the standing repository-wide 'PENDING_EXACT_HEAD_GREEN' CI validation already declared in EPOCH24_RELATIVE_VALUE_DIAGNOSTIC_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_V1.json and EPOCH24_RELATIVE_VALUE_PAIR_DATA_IMPLEMENTATION_MANIFEST_V1.json, not by any missing code, test, or manifest.
